lead.headline: U.S.-Iran truce memorandum expires with no talks under way
lead.dek: Neither side proposed an extension, and the Strait of Hormuz stays closed.
body: The 60-day deadline the United States and Iran set for a permanent peace deal expired Monday with no negotiations under way, leaving the Strait of Hormuz shut and each government blaming the other.

The 14-point memorandum signed June 17 traded a ceasefire, the lifting of the U.S. naval blockade and $300B in reconstruction for Iran clearing mines from the strait. It broke down within weeks over which shipping route Iran would accept, and President Donald Trump declared it over on July 7.
Iran wants the blockade lifted, U.S. forces withdrawn and war reparations; Trump has rejected all three. Pakistan's foreign ministry said it is still working to bring both sides to a table.

briefs.headline: Judge blocks the FBI headquarters move to the Reagan Building
briefs.summary: U.S. District Judge Theodore Chuang found the diversion of more than $323M from the planned Greenbelt, Maryland, site arbitrary and capricious.

briefs.headline: Mangione's state murder trial is postponed indefinitely
briefs.summary: Judge Gregory Carro canceled the Sept. 8 trial while the defense argues double jeopardy after the federal guilty plea. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

briefs.headline: Part of the 1934 firearms law lapses after a Texas ruling
briefs.summary: Judge James Wesley Hendrix found that zeroing out the $200 transfer tax in 2025 removed the basis for registering suppressors.

briefs.headline: Kelly asks for an investigation of USS Lincoln conditions
briefs.summary: The Arizona senator said a sailor's grandmother told him her grandson had lost 20 to 25 pounds on the nine-month deployment.

briefs.headline: Kushner's Gaza talks close without a breakthrough
briefs.summary: Netanyahu's office called Monday's meeting constructive but held that no reconstruction begins before Hamas disarms.

briefs.headline: Hichilema wins a second term in Zambia with 61.4%
briefs.summary: Brian Mundubile took 38% of about 5 million votes. EU observers cited unequal campaign conditions.

briefs.headline: Flores quake toll reaches 68 as aid moves by air
briefs.summary: More than 200 were injured by Saturday's magnitude 7.7 quake. A 14-day emergency is in force.

briefs.headline: Four of Europe's big rivers hit record-low levels
briefs.summary: The European Commission's Joint Research Centre reported records on the Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube.

briefs.headline: Fayette woman dies in floodwaters as damage surveys open
briefs.summary: A woman drowned when her vehicle was swept away in the Pax area during Sunday's flash flooding. The county is asking residents to file state damage surveys.

briefs.headline: Weston middle school moves 400 students to Jackson's Mill
briefs.summary: Gov. Patrick Morrisey advanced $400,000 Monday to relocate Robert L. Bland Middle School, damaged in the July 21 floods, until after Labor Day.

regional.item: Commissioners approved a Lubeck PSD rise Monday of 18% on water and 8% on sewer in September.

briefs.headline: Two astronauts to swap a space station antenna Tuesday
briefs.summary: NASA's Anil Menon and ESA's Sophie Adenot will replace a high-speed data antenna on the Z1 truss, starting at 8:35 a.m. ET.

briefs.headline: Magnetar data points to an effect Heisenberg predicted
briefs.summary: X-ray polarization from the magnetar 1E 1547.0-5408 matches vacuum birefringence, in which virtual particles bend light in empty space.

briefs.headline: Root bacteria behave nothing like they do in a dish
briefs.summary: Seven corn-root species shifted thousands of proteins on contact with living roots, some becoming mobile and others attaching.
